༄༅/ /tshe dpag med kyi rnal 'byor dang bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshe dpag med kyi rnal 'byor dang bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs/

gang gi mtshan brjod dran pas kyang*/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi dpung bcom nas/ /'chi med tshe yi dpal ster ba/ /tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dir bdag nyid kyis nyams su len pa'i rim pa ltar tshe dpag med kyi rnal 'byor rgyun 'khyer du byed pa ni/ skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis rgyal ba tshe dpag med zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bde ba can nas mgon po tshe dpag med yab sras khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ a pa ra mi ta ā yur+dzñā na sa pā ri wa ra e h+ya hi/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rma byas gtegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rgyal ba tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ dbu rgyan la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs bas brgyan cing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dpes spras pa'i sku las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ de'i g.yas su spyan ras gzigs/ g.yon du mthu chen thob pa/ de'i mtha' skor du rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad ky-is bskor nas bzhugs par gyur/ bslu med mchog gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las sgrol ba'i dpa' bo mchog /dag pa'i zhing du 'dren pa'i thugs rje can/ /mgon po 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtse ba'i gter chen rje btsun spyan ras gzigs/ / mthu stobs nus pa'i mnga' bdag mthu chen thob/ /'khor tshogs rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la/ /bdag cag sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo 'dod yon lnga/ /rab 'byams zhing na mchis pa'i mchod tshogs dang*/ /bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs maṇ+ḍal bcas/ /thugs rje che ldan khyed rnams mnyes phyir 'bul/

/thogs med nas bsags sdig ltung thams cad dang*/ /tshe mthar phyin dang bde ldan zhing mchog tu/ /skye la bar du gcod pa'i nyes pa kun/ /nongs shing 'gyod pa'i yid kyis so sor bshags/ /rang gzhan skye 'phags kun gyis legs bskrun pa'i/ /rnam dkar dge tshogs rnams la rjes yi rang*/ /ma lus phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor bar bskul/ /de dag sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs/ /'dis mtshon legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /bde ldan zhing skye sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /zhes yan lag bdun pa bya/ cung zad spro na/ bde gshegs pa'am/ nyi gzhon 'char ka ma gnyis gang rung brjaud pa'i mthar/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rgyal ba tshe dpag med dang*/ mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mthu chen thob sogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes lan gsum sogs dang*/ de dang sbrel nas bdag la mchi med tshe'i rig 'dzin stsal du gsol/ 'di nas shi 'phos ma thag tu bde ba can gyi zhing du skye bar 'gyur bar byin gyis rlob tu gsol zhes gsol 'debs ci nus byas pa'i mjug tu/ skyabs gnas thams cad kyi sku'i cha dang tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum pa las 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung nas rang gi lus kyi cha rnams la thim par gyur zhes brjod cing bsam/ mthar skyabs gnas rnams rang gi snying gar thim pas rang nyid rgyal ba tshe dpag med zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur pa'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ srin zhi'i tshe dpal bsod nams thams cad 'od dang bdud rtsi kha dog sna tshogs pa dang bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad kyi rnam par bkug nas snying kha'i hrīḥyig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ a ma ra ṇī dzi wan+ti ye swāhā/ brgya rtsa sogs ci 'grub dang*/

'dod na gzungs ring kyang bzla'o/ / mthar yig brgya'am/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ lan gsum dang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdab/ /tshe dpag med mgon 'grub gyur nas/ /zhes sogs dang*/ dus min 'chi ba'i mtshan ma mthong ba nas/ /zhes sogs dang*/ 'di nas nying mtshams sbyar ma thag /zhes sogs bsngo smon ci rigs bya'o// //na mo mañdzu gho ṣa ya/ bskal bzang rgyal ba'i dbang po shākya'i tog /rgyal tshab dam pa mi pham 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyag na rdo rje sogs/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /in+ḍā bhu ti dpal ldan sa ra ha/ /lū hi dril bu pa dang nag po spyod/ /klu sgrub zla grags thogs med sku mched sogs/ /'phags yul paṇa grub rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /snang ba mtha' yas dpal ldan mar me mdzad/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'brom ston thams cad mkhyen/ /srol 'dzin zla med pu to glang shar sogs/ /bka' gdams brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun blo bzang grags/ /rigs pa'i dbang phyug rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen/ /mdo sngags bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhas grub rje/ /'dul ba 'dzin pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'dabs/ /blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i mchog /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /mchog sprul blo bzang ye shes bstan pa'i dpal/ /bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /paṇa chen sprul sku dpal ldan ye shes dbang*/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rgyal sras paṇ+ḍi ta/ grub pa'i dbang phyug blo gros rgya mtsho sogs/ /bshes gnyen dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /skye ba kun tu zhes sogs kyang brjod par bya'o/ /tshul 'di bskul zhing bsgrubs pa'i dges/ /'chi med tshe yi dpal thob cing*/ /bde ldan zhing skye tshe rabs kun/ /dam pa'i mgon gyis rje 'dzin shog /ces tshe dpag med kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mdor bsdus pa 'di ni dad dang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i zam thang mdo'i dge slong blo gros kun dgas 'di lta bu zhig gyis dang nyid kyi gsung 'bum gyi nang du bag chags tsam 'jog phyir kho bo rang nyid kyi lag gis bar du brko bar bya'o zhes bskul ba la brten nas shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba ste bar gyi yi ge ba ni dge slong grags pa dpal 'byor
ro// //maṅgalaṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ tshe dpag med kyi rnal 'byor dang bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs/ - PAGE 282-- PAGE 283-- PAGE 280-
